# PHOENIX AI Harness

> Open-source, provider-agnostic AI agent workspace for supported local and cloud models. Independent AI workspace led by Arisnachy Gómez Díaz in the Dominican Republic. Active development, MIT license, upstream attribution preserved.

- [Official source and documentation](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes)
- [English README](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/blob/main/README.md)
- [Spanish README](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/blob/main/README.es.md)
- [Published releases](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/releases)
- [Issues](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/issues)
- [Third-party attribution](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/blob/main/README.md#license-and-third-party-attribution)

- [Early testers and contributors](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/issues/1959)
- [External skill catalog](https://skills.cat/u/arisnachy)
